featureBased.name: Feature-based Architecture
featureBased.description: Code is organized by feature/domain rather than technical role. Each feature directory contains its own components, services, and types.

clean.name: Clean Architecture
clean.description: Layers are separated by dependency direction — domain is independent of infrastructure.

mvc.name: MVC (Model-View-Controller)
mvc.description: Classic separation: Models for data, Views for presentation, Controllers for routing.

layered.name: Layered Architecture
layered.description: Horizontal layers: presentation → application → domain → infrastructure.

nextjsAppRouter.name: Next.js App Router (Feature-based Modular)
nextjsAppRouter.description: Uses Next.js App Router conventions. Routes are file-system based. Layouts and pages compose the UI tree.

strengths.lowCoupling: Low average coupling ({value} imports/file) — modules are well-separated
strengths.goodFanRatio: Good fan-in/fan-out ratio — modules are reused without being overly dependent
strengths.goodCohesion: Good internal cohesion ({value}%) — modules group related functionality
strengths.stableDependency: Stable dependency direction — most modules depend inward toward stable cores (I={value})
strengths.goodAbstraction: Good abstraction layering ({value}% abstract modules) — interfaces/types decouple consumers
strengths.closeToMainSeq: Close to the Main Sequence (D={value}) — architecture follows stable dependencies principle
strengths.noLayerViolations: No layer violations detected — dependency direction is clean
strengths.noCircularDeps: No direct circular dependencies — file-level import graph is acyclic
strengths.hasTests: Test files detected alongside source — good testing discipline
strengths.hasLinting: Linting/formatting config detected — enforces consistent code style
strengths.hasCI: CI/CD pipeline configured — automated builds and tests

weaknesses.highCoupling: High average coupling ({value} imports/file) — modules depend on too many others
weaknesses.lowCohesion: Low cohesion ({value}%) — files within the same directory don't import each other much
weaknesses.highInstability: High instability (I={value}) — too many modules depend on volatile/concrete layers
weaknesses.farFromMainSeq: Far from the Main Sequence (D={value}) — some modules are both concrete AND unstable (pain zone) or abstract AND stable (useless zone)
weaknesses.layerViolations: {count} layer violation(s): component files importing DB/infrastructure directly (bypassing service layer)
weaknesses.fileCircularDeps: {count} direct circular dependency pair(s) detected — these create tight coupling
weaknesses.noTests: No test files detected — reliability risk
